description.value: COBS Bread is a Canadian franchise of the Australian Bakers Delight chain, baking all products from scratch on-site each day — no freezing or transporting. The 8th at Cambie location offers a broad range of breads, scones, cruffins, croissants, and savoury pastries in a neighbourhood commercial strip. Any unsold baked goods at closing are donated to local charities, a practice consistent across the chain.
